reason: Paying only at the end is a clever hook, but I'm handing my business's front door to a one-man band in Kuwait with no UK clients and no reviews. I've already had designers DMing me this month and I'm not shopping, so this goes on the 'maybe later' pile.
objection: If he's busy, gets a better client or just vanishes, who looks after my site? That £43 a month care plan is only worth anything if he's still around in two years, and then there's the SEO upsell at £325 a month on top. I don't want to be stuck with ongoing costs to someone I can't reach in my time zone.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three UK business owners I can actually ring who say he delivered and still answers his phone months later, plus a plain written promise that I can take the site and hosting elsewhere any time with no fee.
